description: 权限中心运行态模板 - 以权限点为中心聚合角色、账号、页面、接口、测试进度和延期原因

access_steps: 从首页进入 流程中心
点击左侧菜单 审批管理
进入审批列表后打开 提交审批

deferred_roles.reason: Employee role has not produced a valid auth snapshot yet.

status_definitions.pending: Discovered from baseline but not yet closed
status_definitions.surveying: Navigator is collecting page or API evidence for this permission
status_definitions.ready_for_replay: Enough evidence exists to run replay tests
status_definitions.testing: Security is actively testing this permission target
status_definitions.deferred: Testing is postponed until auth, evidence, or timing conditions are satisfied
status_definitions.final_stage: Reserved for intercept-first or irreversible-action testing
status_definitions.closed: Permission target has enough evidence and stable results

_contract_notes.entry_points: Bind concrete menu, button, list-row, detail-page, or direct-URL entry information to each permission target.
_contract_notes.access_steps: Store the shortest reproducible navigation path for returning to this permission target later.
_contract_notes.ui_locations: Keep lightweight page-position context; text steps and simple locators are preferred over heavy DOM schemas.
_contract_notes.related_apis: Keep a lightweight API list for display and coarse filtering; cross-account replay must use api_evidence_samples as the primary index.
_contract_notes.api_evidence_samples: Navigator creates samples for permission-bound API evidence. history_entry_id may be null until Security binds it from Burp history using request_fingerprint, method, URL, source account, and time window.
_contract_notes.confirmed_request_samples: Compatibility view derived from api_evidence_samples where replay_ready=true.
_contract_notes.replay_matrix: Track denied replay by permission_key + sample_id + target_account_id so later accounts can quickly replay earlier accounts' evidence without global history scans.
_contract_notes.matched_history_ids: For irreversible actions, record matched_history_id values and keep them bound to the source permission target.
